data.title: 矢来美羽 · 屋顶上的联络
data.description: 屋顶风大，她按住帽檐，听完对讲机里的消息后才看向海面。
data.action: holding a radio and steadying her cap
data.promptProse: Standing on a high sea-facing rooftop terrace during a blustery twilight, Miu holds a handheld security radio to her ear with one hand while holding her security cap firmly with the other. The vast horizon meets the darkening ocean with crashing white breakers below, while sweeping radio antennas and evening clouds dramatize the coastal gust.
data.animaCaption: Soft rooftop light reveals her face, radio and the sea horizon.
